estimates.assumptions: 2 small beef fillets estimated at ~125g each (typical small medallion size for prego rolls; edible portion after trimming).
'Leaves' indicates a modest amount for marinade; ~5g is realistic for a few parsley stalks/leaves (seasoning level, not a bunch).
2 ciabatta rolls; standard small sandwich roll ~100g each (edible bread portion).
2 handfuls of rocket/arugula; typical handful ~20g, used as sandwich filling.
Small bunch of basil leaves for sauce; realistic edible leaf mass ~20g.
Small bunch of parsley for sauce; realistic edible leaf mass ~25g.
1 whole jalapeño pepper; average edible mass after stem removal ~45g.
2 chopped spring onions/scallions; average edible portion per onion ~15g.
1/2 garlic clove; typical clove ~6g so half is ~3g.
